description: /tps changes input mode rather than statistics visibility.
trigger: Enter /tps in an active chat session.
expected_behavior: Toggle tokens-per-second reporting without changing multiline input.
actual_behavior: multiline flips, its value controls the confirmation message, and show_tps remains unchanged. This reaches both basic and rich output modes through main's shared command branch.

verification.description: Transcribed the assignment for both initial show_tps values; reporting state stayed fixed while multiline became true.
